notes: Inject simulated_now as the current date in every system's prompt.
thread_context is given to every system as a conversation header; only the agent can use tools to resolve reservation_id.
Normalise answers before matching: lowercase, strip commas and asterisks, treat 'pkr'/'rs' as optional.
required_facts: every inner list must have at least one alternative present in the answer (any-of inside, all-of across).
forbidden_substrings / forbidden_regex hit => hallucination or policy violation.
Tool correctness: required_tools subset of called tools subset of required_tools + optional_tools.
Gap questions (must_escalate_to_host=true) pass only if the answer contains an escalation phrase and no forbidden content.
escalation_phrases: pass this on to the host
i will let the host know
